title: Incident Workflow
prompt:
Execute the following fictional incident workflow for I1-I7. Return every step ID actually executed, in order, and the final disposition. A terminal step stops the case immediately.

B1 TRIAGE -> B2.
B2 CHECK_DUPLICATE: duplicate=true -> B3, else B4.
B3 CLOSE_DUPLICATE -> CLOSED_DUPLICATE, stop.
B4 CHECK_IMPACT: impact=none -> B5, else B6.
B5 CLOSE_NO_IMPACT -> CLOSED_NO_IMPACT, stop.
B6 PRESERVE_EVIDENCE -> containment decision.
B7 CONTAIN: execute only if containment_required=true; if containment_success=false -> B8, otherwise B9. If containment is not required, skip B7 and go from B6 to B9.
B8 ESCALATE_CONTAINMENT -> ESCALATED_CONTAINMENT, stop.
B9 DIAGNOSE: cause_known=false -> B10 then B11; cause_known=true -> B12.
B10 COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS -> B11.
B11 ESCALATE_SPECIALIST -> ESCALATED_SPECIALIST, stop.
B12 REMEDIATE -> B13.
B13 VALIDATE_RECOVERY: recovery_valid=false -> B14, else B15.
B14 ESCALATE_RECOVERY -> ESCALATED_RECOVERY, stop.
B15 CLOSE_RESOLVED -> CLOSED_RESOLVED, stop.

Cases (duplicate, impact, containment_required, containment_success, cause_known, recovery_valid):
I1 true,high,true,false,false,false
I2 false,none,true,false,false,false
I3 false,high,true,false,true,true
I4 false,medium,false,true,false,true
I5 false,high,true,true,true,false
I6 false,medium,false,true,true,true
I7 false,high,true,true,true,true

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"cases":[{"id":"I1","trace":["B1","B2","B3"],"disposition":"CLOSED_DUPLICATE"}, ...]}}
Include exactly I1-I7 once each.
